tasks.instruction: Match each description (A-L) to the correct organisation. Three descriptions do not match any of them.

options.text: Its World Service broadcasts in dozens of languages to listeners in other countries.
It is responsible for issuing passports to British citizens.
Its red pillar boxes are a familiar sight on streets all over Britain.
It was created in 1948 to provide care that is free at the point of use.
Every address in the country has a short code of letters and numbers used to sort deliveries.
It introduced the world's first adhesive postage stamp, the Penny Black, in 1840.
It runs the country's motorway network.
Patients normally see a general practitioner first, who can refer them to a specialist.
It is one of the largest employers in the world, with well over a million staff.
It was founded in 1922 and is one of the oldest broadcasters in the world.
It organises the national census once every ten years.
Households in the UK that watch live television pay an annual licence fee that funds it.
